newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Daye Steel plans to offer 100 mln A shares.
newsitem.headline: Daye Steel plans to offer 100 mln A shares.

text.p: China-based Daye Special Steel Co Ltd has applied to the China Securities Regulatory Commission for an initial public offering of 100 million A shares for listing in Shenzhen, a company spokesman said on Tuesday.

Shenyin & Wanguo Securities Co Ltd has been named lead underwriter for the offer, the pricing and timing of which have yet to be decided, the spokesman told the China Securities Bulletin, a Hong Kong-based newsletter.

If the offer was approved, Daye would use the proceeds to repay debts incurred for the construction of a 530 million yuan steel project scheduled for completion by the end of 1996, the official said but gave no more details.
Daye, based in the Hubei city of Huangshi, has total share capital of 275.30 million shares, including 225.30 million state shares, 20 million legal person shares and 30 million staff shares.
The official did not give Daye's earnings record over the past few years but said it distributed 0.25 yuan in cash as dividend for every share for 1995 and 0.26 yuan a share for 1994.
